```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Packages used in the project
required_packages <- c(
  "tidyverse",
  "shiny",
  "bslib"
  )

# Feature for automatically installing and downloading packages
load_or_install <- function(packages) {
  for (pkg in packages) {
    if (!require(pkg, character.only = TRUE)) {
      install.packages(pkg, dependencies = TRUE)
      library(pkg, character.only = TRUE)
    }
  }
}

load_or_install(required_packages)
```

## Development Guides

### General Guidelines

- All interface elements and outputs must be presented in Spanish.

- Outputs shown to users should be written in clear, easy-to-interpret text. In other words, prioritize human-readable explanations over technical descriptions.

- Prefer simple, readable, and reproducible code over unnecessarily complex solutions.

- At this stage, the priority is a functional application. Visual and aesthetic improvements will be implemented in future versions.

- All variable handling must occur within the local environment. Data curation and manipulation should be performed in this script immediately before each module or section.

- **Important:** Variable names must remain unchanged (immutable). However, they should be translated into human-readable Spanish concepts when presented outputs to users. 

- The use of the tidyverse ecosystem is preferred (functions, data manipulation, naming conventions, data structures, etc.).

### Additional Recommendations

#### Code Structure and Organization

- Remember the app is divided into logical modules. Pre-processing need to be dveloped in "Procesamiento de datos", your code inside the "Pestaña n".
- Use consistent naming conventions for objects and functions.
- Keep functions short and focused on a single task.
- Avoid code duplication; reuse functions whenever possible.

#### Reproducibility

- Ensure the script can run from start to finish without manual intervention.
- Set a seed when using random processes (`set.seed()`).
- Clearly state package dependencies (e.g., using `renv`, `DESCRIPTION`, or a requirements section in the README).

#### Collaboration and Version Control

- Document major decisions or assumptions within the code (comments).
- Keep code clean and remove unused variables or commented-out blocks before committing.

#### Documentation

- Comment code where necessary, especially in complex sections.
- Provide brief descriptions for your section in "Explanation Pestaña n"

#### Data Handling and Validation

- Validate inputs and handle missing or inconsistent data explicitly.
- Include basic error handling to prevent app crashes.
- Clearly define how missing values (`NA`) are treated.

#### User Experience (UX)

- Ensure outputs are intuitive and informative, even for non-technical users.
- Avoid overloading the interface with too much information at once.
- Use progressive disclosure: show detailed results only when needed.

#### Performance

- Avoid unnecessary recalculations inside reactive contexts.
- Use reactive expressions efficiently in Shiny.
- Optimize data manipulation steps.

### Optional (Highly Recommended)

- Follow a consistent style guide (e.g., tidyverse style guide).

## Loading dataset

```{r}
#| label: Load dataset

path = "Lupus_App_dataset.csv"

load_lupus_data <- function(path) {
  raw_data <- read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE)
  
  curated_data <- raw_data %>%
    mutate(
      across(
        where(is.character),
        ~ na_if(., "")
      )
    )
  
  return(curated_data)
}

lupus_data <- load_lupus_data(path)
```

```{r}
formated_lupus_data <- lupus_data %>%

treatment_labels <- c(
  "Antimaláricos",
  "Corticoesteroides",
  "Ácido micofenólico",
  "Azatioprina",
  "Metotrexato",
  "Rituximab",
  "Ciclosporina",
  "Ciclofosfamida",
  "Otros"
)

formated_lupus_data <- formated_lupus_data %>% 
  rowwise() %>% 
  mutate(
    treatment_summary = paste(
      treatment_labels[
        c_across(starts_with("treatment___")) == 1
      ],
      collapse = ", "
    ),
    
    treatment_summary = ifelse(
      treatment_summary == "",
      "Ninguno",
      treatment_summary
    ),
    
    num_treatments = sum(c_across(starts_with("treatment___"))),
    
    any_treatment = num_treatments > 0
  ) %>% 
  ungroup()

family_labels <- c(
  "Papá","Mamá","Herman@s","Abuel@",
  "Tí@","Prim@","Sobrin@","Hij@","Otro"
)

formated_lupus_data <- formated_lupus_data %>% 
  rowwise() %>% 
  mutate(
    # resumen de familiares con lupus
    family_member_sle_summary = if (family_sle == "Sí") {
      vals <- family_labels[
        c_across(starts_with("family_member_sle___")) == 1
      ]
      if (length(vals) == 0) "No especificado" else paste(vals, collapse = ", ")
    } else {
      NA_character_
    },
    
    # número de familiares
    num_family_members_sle = if (family_sle == "Sí") {
      sum(c_across(starts_with("family_member_sle___")))
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },
    
    # familiares de primer grado
    has_first_degree_sle = if (family_sle == "Sí") {
      sum(c_across(c(
        family_member_sle___0,
        family_member_sle___1,
        family_member_sle___2,
        family_member_sle___7
      ))) > 0
    } else {
      NA
    }
  ) %>% 
  ungroup()


formated_lupus_data <- formated_lupus_data %>% 
  mutate(
    # tratamiento total REAL (incluye corticoide)
    total_treatments = num_treatments + ifelse(uses_corticosteroids, 1, 0),
    
    treatment_profile = case_when(
      
      total_treatments == 0 ~ "Sin tratamiento",
      
      total_treatments == 1 & uses_corticosteroids ~ 
        paste0("Monoterapia: Corticoide (", prednisolona, ")"),
      
      total_treatments == 1 ~ 
        paste0("Monoterapia: ", treatment_summary),
      
      total_treatments > 1 ~ 
        paste0(
          "Politerapia: ",
          ifelse(
            treatment_summary == "Ninguno",
            paste0("Corticoide (", prednisolona, ")"),
            paste0(
              treatment_summary,
              ifelse(
                uses_corticosteroids,
                paste0(", Corticoide (", prednisolona, ")"),
                ""
              )
            )
          )
        )
    )
  )

glimpse(formated_lupus_data)
```

## Shiny App

```{r}
#| label: Lupus App

# Procesamiento de datos

# Interfaz de Usuario (UI)
ui <- page_navbar(
  title = "LupusRGMX Data App",
  theme = bs_theme(version = 5, bootswatch = "flatly"),
  
  # Pestaña 1: Reporte General
  nav_panel(title = "Reporte General",
            sidebarLayout(
              sidebarPanel(
                h4("Filtros Generales"),
                # Aquí irán los selectInput para Edad, Sexo, SLEDAI, etc.
                selectInput("var_gen", "Selecciona variables:", choices = c("Edad", "Sexo", "Comorbilidades"), multiple = TRUE),
                actionButton("run_gen", "Generar Reporte", class = "btn-primary")
              ),
              mainPanel(
                h3("Resumen Descriptivo"),
                textOutput("txt_reporte_gen") # Salida de texto reactiva
              )
            )
  ),
  
  # Pestaña 2: Modelado Estadístico
  nav_panel(title = "Modelado Estadístico",
            sidebarLayout(
              sidebarPanel(
                h4("Configuración del Modelo"),
                selectInput("var_target", "Variable Objetivo (Target):", choices = c("SLEDAI", "Calidad de Vida", "Nefritis Lúpica")),
                selectInput("var_predict", "Variables Predictoras (Features):", choices = c("Uso de Corticoesteroides", "Tiempo de diagnóstico"), multiple = TRUE),
                radioButtons("modelo_tipo", "Tipo de Modelo:", choices = c("Regresión Lineal", "Regresión Binomial", "Chi-cuadrada")),
                actionButton("run_model", "Ejecutar Modelo", class = "btn-primary")
              ),
              mainPanel(
                h3("Resultados del Modelo"),
                textOutput("txt_reporte_modelo") # Salida de texto reactiva
              )
            )
  ),
  
  # Pestaña 3: Neurolupus
  nav_panel(title = "Neurolupus",
            sidebarLayout(
              sidebarPanel(
                h4("Filtros Neurológicos"),
                selectInput("var_neuro", "Variables de Interés:", choices = c("Lesiones Tractos", "Eventos Cerebrovasculares", "Puntaje MoCA"), multiple = TRUE),
                actionButton("run_neuro", "Generar Reporte", class = "btn-primary")
              ),
              mainPanel(
                h3("Reporte Neurocognitivo y de Imagen"),
                textOutput("txt_reporte_neuro") # Salida de texto reactiva
              )
            )
  ),
  
  
  # Pestaña 4: Expresión Génica
  nav_panel(title = "Expresión Génica",
            sidebarLayout(
              sidebarPanel(
                h4("Análisis Transcriptómico"),
                selectInput("var_gene", "Selecciona Gene(s):", 
                            choices = c("IFNIT", "STAT1", "OAS1", "MX1"), 
                            multiple = TRUE),
                radioButtons("plot_type", "Tipo de visualización:", 
                             choices = c("Boxplot de Expresión", "Volcano Plot", "Heatmap")),
                actionButton("run_gene", "Analizar Expresión", class = "btn-primary")
              ),
              mainPanel(
                h3("Resultados de Expresión Diferencial"),
                textOutput("txt_reporte_gene"), # Salida de texto
                plotOutput("plot_gene")        # Espacio para gráfica futura
              )
            )
  ),
  
  # Pestaña 5: Acceso a Datos
  nav_panel(title = "Acceso a Datos Crudos",
            div(class = "container mt-5",
                h2("Solicitud de Datos"),
                p("Los datos crudos de este estudio se encuentran resguardados para proteger la privacidad de las y los participantes."),
                p("Si eres investigador y deseas acceder a la base de datos para análisis colaborativos, por favor completa el formulario de solicitud formal."),
                br(),
                a(href = "URL_DE_TU_REDCAP", target = "_blank", class = "btn btn-lg btn-success", "Ir al Formulario en RedCap")
            )
  )
)

# Lógica del Servidor (Server)
server <- function(input, output, session) {
  
  # Lógica Pestaña 1
  observeEvent(input$run_gen, {
    output$txt_reporte_gen <- renderText({
      paste("Reporte generado para las variables:", paste(input$var_gen, collapse = ", "), 
            ". Aquí se insertará la lógica para calcular y redactar promedios, conteos, etc.")
    })
  })
  
  # Lógica Pestaña 2
  observeEvent(input$run_model, {
    output$txt_reporte_modelo <- renderText({
      paste("Ejecutando", input$modelo_tipo, "para predecir", input$var_target, 
            "utilizando", paste(input$var_predict, collapse = ", "), 
            ". Aquí se interpretarán los coeficientes y el p-value en formato texto.")
    })
  })
  
  # Lógica Pestaña 3
  observeEvent(input$run_neuro, {
    output$txt_reporte_neuro <- renderText({
      paste("Reporte de Neurolupus generado para:", paste(input$var_neuro, collapse = ", "),
            ". Aquí se describirán las asociaciones entre los puntajes clínicos y los hallazgos de resonancia.")
    })
  })
  
   # Lógica Pestaña 4
    observeEvent(input$run_gene, {
      output$txt_reporte_gene <- renderText({
        paste("Analizando la expresión de los genes:", paste(input$var_gene, collapse = ", "), 
              "mediante un", input$plot_type, 
              ". En esta sección se integrará el análisis de cuentas normalizadas o Fold-Change.")
      })
      
      # Placeholder para la gráfica
      output$plot_gene <- renderPlot({
        # Aquí irá la lógica de ggplot2 una vez se carguen los datos de expresión
      })
    })
    
    
  }


shinyApp(ui, server)

```
